title: Rules of the Supreme Court 1971
converter: docx2txt.py (method of p2au_wa_fetch.py, checked by reproducing the Coroners Regulations 1997 deposit byte for byte): word/document.xml paragraphs, one per line, tabs kept, line breaks as spaces, non-breaking hyphens as '-', trailing whitespace and empty paragraphs dropped

symbol_repair_2026_11_07.how: regenerated from the same Word file (sha256 cfed66d4a364e2c0beb2e2a84665cf47fe59dd252af3ff13b4cc4b5d656cc2da) with wa_docx2txt_sym.py, a copy of the deposit's converter docx2txt.py fixed to map w:sym symbol characters instead of dropping them (kept outside the repository); the unfixed converter reproduces the previous deposit byte for byte, and a diff against it shows only the 34 restored characters on 33 lines. Header and line structure unchanged (11,538 lines).
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.why: docx2txt.py read only w:t, w:tab, w:noBreakHyphen and w:br/w:cr, so the 34 w:sym characters in the Word file were dropped.
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.what_changed: Only tick boxes and bullets: 32 Monotype Sorts F070 tick boxes restored as "[ ]" (Schedule 2 forms: Form 5AA lines 8613-8614; Form 8 lines 8751-8752; Form 22A lines 9183-9184; Form 67A lines 10212-10219, 10224, 10229; Form 85 lines 10489-10490, 10493-10494; Form 86 lines 10530-10531; Form 101 lines 10654 (two), 10655, 10672-10673; Form 102 lines 10699-10700; Form 103 lines 10726-10728), and 2 Wingdings F09F bullets restored as "•" (Form 4, lines 8574-8575). Without the boxes the alternatives on these forms read as plain statements. No decimal point, multiplication, minus or comparison sign was lost, and the text has no private-use code point.
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.encodings_affected: none: baseline-2026-11 relies on no changed line (the forms of O. 4AA r. 3, O. 8 r. 5A, O. 12 r. 11, O. 36B r. 10(3), O. 56 r. 2, O. 65 rr. 12-13 and O. 81C r. 2 are outside its scope), so no rule, case or finding changed
